annotations.title: Compare two US stocks, or a stock and an ETF

description: Two US stocks with three years of prices: market cap, valuation, returns, worst fall, volatility, beta, the correlation of weekly returns, and the covered US ETFs holding both. A fund ticker works on one side and returns whether the fund holds the stock, at what weight and rank.

a.description: A US stock ticker, for example NVDA. An ETF ticker also works.

name: compare_stocks
title: Compare two US stocks, or a stock and an ETF
